Responsibility roadmap and preliminary cases, not an algorithm or ranking.

RSIAgent: broad/deep environment exploration and frozen downstream memory.
SoL-Pi: retained efficient mechanisms; overview abstract and legacy body record remain distinguishable.
Designer-RSI: procedural memory widening/deepening under matched replay and noisy grading.
RRSI: regularized proposer and critic/pruner selection, not monotonicity guarantee.
AIDE2: accepted code rewrites; legacy ignition body evidence kept separately.
DCE + SRCL: privileged teacher evolves and verified concise responses train student; ground truth remains supervision.
RSI-Master: Experiment OS plus worker/reviewer DAG; protocol-dependent outcomes.
Intelligence-explosion scenario and policy analysis, not a measured recursive algorithm.
MASS: workflow evolution/shared SFT; October 12 announcement remains a separate date.
AReaL-RSI: persistent team and conditional memory; overview 20226 is an explicit user typo.
SwarmRSI: feedback-guided mutation/complementary recombination; November 2 revision not first date.

HarnessPro: self-generated tests and cost/performance selection; independent truth not established.
RSIHub: shared recipes/operators/evaluation/lineage; held-out transfer not automatic.
Trustworthy RSI operational definition, risks and evidence responsibilities; not a new algorithm.
CogRSI: learned principles can improve accuracy and still fail executable rule audits; submission date overrides ID prefix.
CoworkOS: persistent runtime and delegation, with post-training case rather than demonstrated runtime self-evolution.
AgentEvolver: self-questioning, experience-guided navigation and contribution-based reward; preliminary evidence.
Live-SWE-agent: on-the-fly scaffold modification; cross-task persistence not established from abstract.
Agent0: tool-integrated curriculum/executor co-evolution; zero data is not zero prior knowledge or environment.
VLM judge self-training on synthetic quality levels and filtered reasoning; expected levels are not independent truth.
SAGE: sequential rollout carries skills across tasks; skill-integrated reward complements outcomes; expert-experience SFT starting point retained.
MemRL: utility learning over episodic memory and two-phase retrieval, no model-weight update.
MemSkill: learned controller and designer-evolved memory operations; designer-improvement causality not established by abstract.
SAHOO: drift, constraints and regression-risk checks; finite calibration/task scope is not long-term alignment guarantee.
Meta-TTL: inner sequential-episode TTL and outer reflective meta-training with balanced improvement score; fixed outer process remains distinct.
RewardHarness: preference-grounded context/tool/skill evolution for reward scoring; training-free scorer is not annotation-free.
Adaptive Auto-Harness: persistent workspace separate from deployment, continued revision under drift; accumulation alone insufficient.
Bounded-to-research survey, separate evaluator design space; qualitative verification hierarchy not a universal measured law.
